title: File:NH 96707.jpg
desc: River patrol boat (PBR) crewmen check a Vietnamese identification card, during a patrol in the Mekong Delta and Rung Sat special zone, January 1968. Men are (l-r): Quartermaster First Class Steward Hickman, EngM3 Ronald Bartelmel, GM3 J. D. Glynn. Note Honeywell Mk18 40mm grenade launcher at left, G
artist: Naval History and Heritage Command NH 96707 photo by Lieutenant Junior Grade T. S. Storck, USNR
